actions.action: Water the whole arrangement the day before separating
Pot each plant in its own drainage pot 1–2 inches wider, using houseplant mix for pilea/syngonium and cactus mix for kalanchoe
Keep the pumpkin as a cachepot with the nursery pot inside
Ease the pilea out, tease roots gently, and plant at the same depth, firming the soil
Check that the top inch of soil is dry before watering again
Keep the pilea in bright indirect light out of direct sun for a week
